aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS or TACACS+) in Alcatel AOS.
aaa_enabled.notes: Define your server group first and assign it as the default authentication source, falling back to local.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Restrict remote VTY access to SSH only by disabling Telnet.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Disable the Telnet service to prevent cleartext remote administration sessions.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Specify the idle timeout in minutes (e.g. 15 minutes) for CLI sessions.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure user account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Alcatel AOS automatically hashes/encrypts all user administrative passwords at rest.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Change or remove default SNMP community mappings.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Remove standard default community mapping names.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the insecure HTTP WebView management server.
http_server_disabled.notes: Enforce secure management access by disabling unencrypted HTTP.

ssh_version_2.summary: Ensure SSH version is secure (AOS SSH server defaults to SSHv2).

logging_enabled.summary: Configure remote swlog syslog server destination socket.
logging_enabled.notes: Direct log events to your central syslog server collector.

management_acl.summary: Restrict switch CPU management plane access using QoS policies.
cli: policy service ssh protocol 6 destination tcp port 22
policy condition AllowedMgmt source network group "mgmt-hosts" destination network group Switch service ssh
policy condition DenyOtherMgmt source ip 0.0.0.0/0 destination network group Switch service ssh
policy rule AllowMgmt precedence 300 condition AllowedMgmt action AllowAction
policy rule DenyMgmt precedence 200 condition DenyOtherMgmt action DenyAction
management_acl.notes: Restrict SSH and Telnet protocols to your defined management network group.

login_banner.notes: Assign a pre-created text file in `/flash/switch/` as the CLI login banner.

password_min_length.notes: Specify a minimum length of 8 characters or longer for local accounts.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure upstream NTP time synchronization servers.
ntp_configured.notes: Define NTP servers and ensure the NTP daemon is administratively enabled.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Map SNMP communities to read-only user privileges.
cli: user "snmp_ro_user" password "secure" read-only all no auth
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure mapped SNMP users are configured with read-only authorization.
